messages.body:
Hello Placement Cell,

We are planning our upcoming campus drive for Cybersecurity Analysts and Systems Engineers. We would like to confirm whether October 5th, 2026 is suitable for hosting the online test and preliminary technical interview round.

Could you also verify if Computer Labs A and B with 120 systems will be accessible for the coding round?

Best regards,
Anand Kumar
Head of Talent Acquisition, RedTeam Hacker Academy

Dear Anand,

October 5th, 2026 is confirmed on our placement calendar. Both Computer Labs A and B (equipped with 120 high-speed networked terminals) have been reserved for your technical assessment. Our student coordinators will assist your technical team upon arrival.

Looking forward to a successful recruitment drive.

Warm regards,
Placement & Corporate Relations Cell
LMCST Trivandrum

Greetings from Infosys Campus Recruitment Team.

As part of our preliminary planning for the 2026 batch recruitment drive, could you please share the breakdown of eligible students across Computer Science, Information Technology, and Electronics with an aggregate of 65% and above?

Thank you,
Rajesh Kumar
Head of Campus Talent Acquisition
Thank you for reaching out. We would be happy to discuss your campus recruitment requirements.
